title: Per la storia del testo di Marziale
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: Can we speak, in the case of the Epigrammaton libri , of very ancient variants, perhaps even authorship? This volume proposes a reconstruction of the textual history of the work that runs backwards-from the copyists to the ancient editors, to Martial himself-and aims to distinguish, classify and justify the numerous interventions accumulated on the text.
